description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G} targeting Gatherer of Graces.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 Keimi creature token.
Resolve Rancor, attaching it to Gatherer of Graces.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing Rancor.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Keimi token, adding {G}.
Repeat.
